## Know when a limited child can try again

When a child session hits a provider's rate or quota limit and the provider says how long to wait, the courier now passes that on.

- **The parent session is told when to retry.** Its failure notice gives the wait and the time it ends, and asks it not to message the child before then, since that would only fail again. It can set a `courier_later` reminder for when the wait is over instead. (#353)
- **The tree panel shows it too.** The failed child's row reads `limit, resumes 14:32` until that time passes or the child runs again.

## Tested on OpenCode 2.1.3

The courier now targets OpenCode 2.1.3. Nothing changed in how it behaves. (#352)

## Shorter docs

The README and reference are now about half their previous length, and each topic is covered in one place. (#354)

## What's Changed
* Bump the OpenCode pin to 2.1.3 by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/352
* Trim the human-facing docs to what a reader needs by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/354
* Show when a rate- or quota-limited child can resume by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/355
* Release 0.11.0 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/356


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/compare/v0.10.3...v0.11.0

## What's Changed
* Record and narrate the README demo with scripts: record-demo.sh, render-demo.sh by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/350
* Release 0.10.3 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/351


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/compare/v0.10.2...v0.10.3

## What's Changed
* An archived idle child no longer reads as running (#324) by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/327
* A renamed, unarchived or switched idle child no longer reads as running (#326) by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/329
* Memory refresh reads each session's messages at most once by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/333
* A plain decline's end, reported as a shutdown, is a turn end for the tree and the memory by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/334
* courier_send notes the wake row itself, so a spawn in the same step counts the child it wakes by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/335
* Take turnIn's time at the transcript read in memory refresh by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/338
* Memory refresh: read the top's turn again when it was stamped during the parts phase by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/339
* Assert lengths directly in memory test (S5906) by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/342
* Move the pin to OpenCode 2.1.2 by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/343
* Real-model scenario recursive-staged: a part with a core, and COURIER_SKILL=deny by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/345
* Run the motion tests' pending immediates in the test, so Bun's loop cannot sleep on one (#344) by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/346
* CI on Bun 1.4.2, with @types/bun to match by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/347
* Sandbox results: a part with a core, and a partial report without the skill by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/348
* Release 0.10.2 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/349


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/compare/v0.10.1...v0.10.2

## What's Changed
* Pin OpenCode 2.1.0 by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/323
* Release 0.10.1 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/325


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/compare/v0.10.0...v0.10.1

## What's Changed
* Child brief: a sub-orchestrator loads the skill and does not poll (#298) by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/300
* Root: may hand a heavy task whole to one session, to keep its context by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/301
* real-model.md: the recursive run on the no-poll and skill wording (#298) by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/302
* real-model.sh: a diagnosable run (debug log, probe plugin, timestamps) by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/310
* real-model.md: the deepseek-v4.1-flash-free recursive run at 43393b0 by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/311
* real-model-table: a table per condition, and a floor for a claim by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/312
* real-model.md: what the recursive scenario cannot measure by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/313
* reference.md: what holds without the skill loaded by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/314
* Skill: say why steps 3, 4 and 6 repeat the brief's split rule by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/315
* Brief: the group holds the parts that run at once; a staged core is not the whole task by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/316
* real-model.md: the deepseek-v4.1-flash-free recursive run at 045ae2c by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/317
* real-model: a recursive-fault scenario, one leaf reporting partial until its parent messages it by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/318
* real-model.md: timeline.txt comes from the recursive and recursive-fault scenarios by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/319
* real-model.md: the first recursive-fault run, deepseek-v4.1-flash-free at c8fe885 by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/320
* Release 0.10.0 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/322


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/compare/v0.9.0...v0.10.0
